items.q: How do you verify the engineers are genuinely senior?
items.a: Every engineer has a proven track record on high-scale production systems and passes architecture tests, live coding audits, and security reviews.

items.q: Is our proprietary code or data sent to public AI models?
items.a: No. Our tools run exclusively on enterprise accounts certified for Zero Data Retention (ZDR). Your code and data are never saved or used to train models.
Our engineer works on dedicated Git branches and submits documented Pull Requests. No code is merged without your team's review and approval.

items.q: How does the 5-day risk-free trial work?
items.a: If after the first 5 days you feel velocity or communication doesn't match your standards, you can cancel immediately with no penalty or notice period.

items.q: Can we adjust monthly day volume over time?
items.a: Yes, with total flexibility. You can ramp up to full-time for a product launch, then scale down to 5-10 days/month for ongoing maintenance.

items.q: Where are the developers based and how do they communicate?
items.a: Our engineers work remotely across European time zones in fluent English and French. They integrate directly into your team's Slack with optional on-site workshops.
A transparent B2B service contract with no lock-in. Monthly invoicing based on actual agreed days, zero payroll taxes, and zero severance risk.

items.q: What happens if our product priorities pivot mid-sprint?
items.a: Our engineer is embedded in your agile backlog. If priorities shift, simply reassign tickets on Linear or Jira with zero contract amendments.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We believe in total transparency. Here are answers to the most common questions from our partners.

items.q: Do I own the source code of my website or web application?
items.a: Yes, entirely. Unlike traditional agencies or closed SaaS platforms, you own 100% of the intellectual property. We deliver clean source code to a private GitHub repository in your name. You are free to host it anywhere and work with any developer in the future — no lock-in, ever.

items.q: Can I evolve my website or web application after delivery?
items.a: Absolutely. The code is built to modern web standards (Next.js, React, TypeScript). Any qualified developer worldwide can pick up and modify the project instantly. We also offer monthly support packages to manage your future updates with peace of mind.

items.q: How does AI let you deliver 3× faster without sacrificing quality?
items.a: Our AI orchestration agents automate repetitive tasks: generating code scaffolding, running robustness tests, adapting image formats and drafting content. Our human engineers focus exclusively on what creates value: business architecture, premium aesthetics and conversion strategy.

items.q: Are there hidden fees or mandatory subscriptions after delivery?
items.a: No. The price agreed in the quote is fixed and final for the agreed scope. The only recurring costs are your third-party tool subscriptions (hosting, Stripe, etc.), paid directly to providers — with zero markup or fees from us.

items.q: Are your websites optimised for Google SEO and mobile?
items.a: Yes, it's our absolute priority. Every project is developed Mobile-First and rigorously audited with Google Lighthouse targeting scores above 95/100 for performance and SEO. The result: your clients find you on Google and don't bounce because of slow load times.

sections.content: Lonside endeavors to provide accurate and up-to-date information. However, errors or omissions may occur. Lonside cannot be held liable for the use of the information presented on this site.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: These Terms of Service govern the contractual relationship between Lonside (hereinafter "the Provider") and its clients for web development, design, and automation services.

sections.title: Quotes and Orders
sections.content: Every service is subject to a prior quote signed by both parties. The quote specifies the nature of the services, timelines, delivery terms, and the flat-rate price including taxes.

sections.title: Payment Terms
sections.content: A 40% deposit is payable upon signing the quote. The remaining 60% is due upon final delivery. Any late payment results in penalties of 3 times the legal interest rate.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: The client gains full ownership of the source code, mockups, and all deliverables once full payment is received. Lonside reserves the right to showcase the project in its portfolio.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable resolution before any legal action.

sections.title: Data Collected
sections.content: Lonside collects data that you voluntarily transmit via the contact form: name, email, and message. This data is used exclusively to respond to your inquiries.

sections.title: Audience measurement
sections.content: With your consent, we use Vercel Web Analytics to measure visits and page views on the production website. Navigation data is sent to Vercel to provide these statistics. URL query parameters and fragments are removed before sending. No audience measurement cookies are used. You can refuse or withdraw consent in cookie preferences; further events are then blocked.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: Your data is stored for a maximum period of 3 years from your last interaction with us, in compliance with GDPR guidelines.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: Pursuant to GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, and request portability of your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@lonside.ai.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: This site does not use third-party tracking cookies. Only technical cookies strictly necessary for the operation of the website may be used.

sections.title: What is a cookie?
sections.content: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile) when you visit a website or view an advertisement. Its purpose is to collect information about your browsing habits to provide you with personalized services or to analyze website audience metrics.

sections.title: How do we manage your consent?
sections.content: On your first visit to our site, an information banner notifies you about the presence of cookies and invites you to express your choice. Cookies are only placed if you accept them, with the exception of technical cookies strictly necessary for the site's operation. You can modify your choices at any time by clicking the configuration button below.

sections.title: What types of cookies do we use?
sections.content:
1. Technical cookies (Essential): These cookies are indispensable for browsing the site (such as session identifiers, browser language choice, or recording your cookie consent preferences). They cannot be deactivated.

2. Audience measurement cookies (Statistics): These tools help us understand visitor behavior and overall site utilization to improve its speed and usability. We use Vercel Web Analytics without audience measurement cookies, only with your consent and on the production website. Refusing or withdrawing consent blocks further events.

3. Marketing cookies: These cookies track users across the web to display relevant messages. We do not use any such cookies at this time.
